svg.title: The lab at a glance
svg.desc: One physical host, 13 Incus guests, and a private network shared by services and Kubernetes.

g.text: One physical host, 13 Incus guests, and a private network shared by services and Kubernetes.
Direct service endpoints; HAProxy for Kubernetes UIs
Core i7-12700T • 14 cores / 20 threads • 64 GB RAM • 2 TB NVMe
incusbr0: 10.205.234.0/24 | pool1: instance disks and custom data volumes
External dependencies: Cloudflare DNS, Let’s Encrypt, GitHub / OCI registries, Docker Hub, Brevo email.
All guests share the same physical host and storage pool; guest isolation does not provide host-level availability.
